title: Graph Anomaly Detection as Finite-Horizon Control: Training-Free Scoring via Empirical Bayes
abstract: arXiv:2609.38424v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Node-level graph anomaly detection (GAD) identifies nodes whose attributes and interactions deviate from dominant graph regularities. Existing GAD models encode normality and anomaly scoring indirectly through architectures, message passing, reconstruction or contrastive objectives, and tuned score families. This entangles graph trust (how strongly graph structure should define normality), graph-spectral weighting, and anomaly-score choice, yielding scores that are costly, opaque, and unstable across graph regimes. We propose EB-GAD (Empirical-Bayes GAD), a training-free framework that models normality as graph-aware generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (GOU) relaxation toward a graph-filtered template. Empirical Bayes fits the graph precision from the residual-field likelihood; the GOU then turns scoring into a closed-form finite-horizon control energy, the minimum effort to steer a feature-neutral node to its observed endpoint along graph-sp

translated_title: 将图异常检测视为有限时域控制：基于经验贝叶斯的免训练评分
translated_abstract: 节点级图异常检测（GAD）旨在识别其属性与交互偏离主导图规律性的节点。现有的GAD模型通过架构、消息传递、重构或对比学习目标以及调优的评分函数族，间接地对正常性与异常评分进行编码。这将图信任度（图结构应在多大程度上定义正常性）、图谱加权和异常评分选择三者纠缠在一起，导致评分计算成本高、不透明，且在不同图状态下不稳定。我们提出EB-GAD（经验贝叶斯GAD），这是一个免训练框架，将正常性建模为朝向图过滤模板的图感知广义Ornstein-Uhlenbeck（GOU）松弛过程。经验贝叶斯从残差场似然中拟合图的精度；随后GOU将评分转化为闭式解的有限时域控制能量，即将一个特征中性节点沿图平滑路径引导至其观测端点所需的最小控制努力。
tldr: 提出免训练的图异常检测框架EB-GAD，将正常性建模为向图过滤模板的图感知广义Ornstein-Uhlenbeck松弛，利用经验贝叶斯从数据拟合图精度，从而将异常评分转化为闭式有限时域控制能量，避免了架构调参与评分函数选择的纠缠。
en_tdlr: EB-GAD is a training-free graph anomaly detection framework that models normality as a graph-aware generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck relaxation toward a graph-filtered template, fits graph precision via Empirical Bayes, and turns anomaly scoring into a closed-form finite-horizon control energy, eliminating the entanglement of architecture tuning and score-family selection.
